jsonObj.suggestedValue: As the only government school in Bandwar offering the full Class 1–8 range, MS Bandwar plays a central role in the village's educational pipeline. Students who complete Class 8 here on move on to [[uhs-plus-2-bandwar|UHS +2 Bandwar]] or [[snk-high-school-bandwar|S.N.K. High School]] for their secondary education.
